Principles of Distributed Consensus Protocols

Published by Dr. Sarah Chen | Systems Engineering Research

Introduction to State Machine Replication

Distributed consensus enables a collection of autonomous computing machines to maintain state consistency across network partitions and physical node outages. Protocols such as Raft and Paxos formalize leader election, log replication, and commit invariants.

Quorum Slices and Byzantine Fault Tolerance

In trustless peer environments, quorum intersections provide Byzantine fault tolerance by ensuring that no conflicting transactions achieve finality across overlapping validator subsets.
